items.source: Marker interface to describe configuration classes that ship Jackson modules that are supposed to be added to the Jackson 3 ObjectMapper configured for EnableSpringDataWebSupport.
items.translation: 标记接口，用于描述那些随 Jackson 模块一起分发的配置类。这些模块旨在被添加到为 EnableSpringDataWebSupport 配置的 Jackson 3 ObjectMapper 中。
奥利弗·吉尔克，马克·帕卢赫
